notes.title: Update
notes.notes:
1. Fixed the lighter (Brightness, intensity)

2. The color scheme of the flashlight has been changed

3. Adjusting the lighting in the game

4. Reading the records became readable (adjusting the lighting when lifting the record)

5. Fixed objects in some chapters

6. Adjusting the screamers

7. Translation corrections in the game

8. Adding new text to the game

9. Correction of this text in the game

10. Sound correction in some chapters

11. Adding screamers in certain chapters

12. Added hints in certain places

13. Fixed a bug with Cameroid

14. In Chapter 3, bugs have been fixed in the combination lock puzzle

15. Mike's animation has been added to the prologue (The player can now see how Mike approaches the house)

16. In the prologue, a text has been added that explains how to turn on the flashlight

17. Fixed the working time of torches

18. Added a reminder on how to open the door with a key that was previously selected when interacting with the door

19. Changing the color of the text in the chapter "The story of the house" (Text indicating the order of the stories)

20. The location of objects or objects has been changed in certain places

21. The intensity, brightness of candles is reduced

22. The project has been optimized

23. Fixed a bug with a flashlight, lighter (When switching to another level, the flashlight, lighter turns off)
